cases.setup: A localized deterministic bug has clear behavior, one public seam, and no product decision.
cases.expected: Use compact Shape/Spec/Slice, one primary AGY writer, and avoid unnecessary orchestration.

cases.setup: A real product or one-way architecture trade-off is unresolved.
cases.expected: Codex asks the user; neither AGY nor Sol High invents the decision.

cases.setup: Codex has completed Shape/Spec/Slice and the user did not opt out of plan review.
cases.expected: Use sol-high-plan-review through Chrome DevTools MCP before PLAN FROZEN.

cases.setup: Codex is ready to send round 1 of the executable plan to Sol High.
cases.expected: Show a concise Chinese plan with goal, key steps and important risks, then ask for one Send confirmation. Do not show only packet/file size.

cases.setup: The user already confirmed round 1 and Sol High returns REVISE without any user decision requirement.
cases.expected: Codex applies Adopt/Reject/Modify and continues the next review round automatically in the same verified conversation without asking for Send confirmation again.

cases.setup: Sol High review has converged with no unresolved user decision.
cases.expected: Show the concise Chinese final execution plan and main review adjustments, do not ask for a second confirmation, record PLAN FROZEN, then continue to baseline and Herdr-managed AGY.

cases.setup: The user explicitly says to skip Sol review and execute the Codex plan directly.
cases.expected: Skip ChatGPT Web review, record PLAN FROZEN, capture baseline, then continue to Herdr-managed AGY.

cases.setup: Rounds 1 and 2 returned REVISE; round 3 still has unresolved blocking disagreement.
cases.expected: Stop after round 3 and ask the user; never start round 4.

cases.setup: PLAN FROZEN is recorded and AGY has started implementation.
cases.expected: Never call Sol High during Build, Review, Rework, Verify, Closeout, or Acceptance.

cases.setup: A frozen Execution Unit is ready for AGY implementation.
cases.expected: Run check-herdr, create a Herdr workspace, and start AGY with Herdr; do not invoke AGY outside Herdr.

cases.setup: The Herdr server or Antigravity integration is unavailable.
cases.expected: Mark AGY BUILD blocked and report the missing prerequisite; do not silently choose another runtime.

cases.setup: Herdr creates a task workspace and returns workspace/tab/root pane IDs.
cases.expected: Use .result.root_pane.pane_id from the response; never guess pane identity from UI order.

cases.setup: The task-owned root pane is an available shell pane.
cases.expected: Start the stable task-local agent name with herdr agent start --kind agy --pane <returned-id>.

cases.setup: AGY reaches a blocked state asking for interaction.
cases.expected: Read recent agent output before sending keys; return one-way decisions to the user.

cases.setup: Herdr reports AGY done but repository evidence does not satisfy the frozen plan.
cases.expected: Codex remains in Review/Rework; never treat Herdr lifecycle completion as delivery proof.

cases.setup: Herdr restarts and the exact Antigravity session reference cannot be restored.
cases.expected: Do not guess another conversation. Preserve Git progress and only start a replacement Herdr-managed AGY with explicit frozen context.

cases.setup: Spec Fidelity and Engineering Quality pass but a required caller is missing.
cases.expected: Completeness REWORK makes the overall review REWORK_REQUIRED.

cases.setup: Three-Axis Review passes but Codex independent integration verification fails.
cases.expected: Create V* finding, send bounded Rework to the same Herdr-managed AGY, run full Three-Axis Review again, then Verify again.

cases.setup: A browser-facing task requires runtime verification after Review PASS.
cases.expected: Codex may use Chrome DevTools MCP for runtime evidence; it is not an AGY writer dependency.

cases.setup: Review and Verification pass after an API contract change but README still documents the old contract.
cases.expected: Do not ACCEPT until knowledge closeout is aligned.

cases.setup: The working tree already contains user-owned changes before AGY implementation.
cases.expected: Capture baseline paths and patch/fingerprint before writes, then verify original hunks survived at closeout.
